in_sanskrit.name: ओम्पल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The sound that represents the ultimate reality and the creator of the universe

in_hindi.name: Ompal
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ompal एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ompal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Omkara', which represents the sound of the universe. The name Ompal is believed to signify the supreme lord who pervades and governs the entire cosmos.
